text:
The plan fails one hard requirement.

**Fix:** pricing must depend on webhooks. Set `pricing.depends_on` to `["webhooks"]`. It is currently empty.

Because every dependency must come earlier in "order", move webhooks ahead of pricing. For example: `"order": ["webhooks", "pricing", "billing", "upload", "quota", "ledger"]`.

Leave everything else unchanged. Return only the single JSON object.
